courier-relay/protocol-1-delivery-identi: Courier Relay protocol-1 delivery identity (source: vendor/protocol-1.md): delivery_id ALONE identifies a delivery across ALL accounts, not per-account. Two receipts with the same delivery_id but different account_id are duplicates of the same delivery identity, not separate identities -- account attribution never changes this. Exactly one receipt is accepted per delivery_id: the one with the earliest occurred_at UTC instant (compare as UTC, converting any explicit numeric offset); ties broken by smallest record_id in Unicode code-point order. All other receipts sharing that delivery_id are duplicates. This applies to any command that groups/accepts/dedupes receipts under protocol 1 (e.g. count, and future commands that list or return accepted receipts), even when a given request happens to be scoped to one account_id.
